dft-vehicle-licensing.title: DfT vehicle licensing statistics
dft-vehicle-licensing.description: Quarterly counts of licensed vehicles in the United Kingdom, produced by the Department for Transport from DVLA registration data: how many vehicles are licensed, of what body type, running on what fuel, under private or company keepership, registered in which local authority.

police-crime-london.title: Street-level crime, outcomes and stop & search — London
police-crime-london.description: Every crime and anti-social-behaviour incident recorded by London's two territorial police forces (the Metropolitan Police Service and City of London Police) since December 2010, with case outcomes and stop & search records, as published on data.police.uk. The full history is assembled from data.police.uk's permanent monthly archives, each month taken from the most recent archive that contains it (the most-revised version). Locations are anonymised by data.police.uk; British Transport Police are excluded.

gla-trees.title: London public realm trees (GLA / GiGL)
gla-trees.description: Tree-level inventory of London's publicly maintained realm — around 1.14 million street, park and other public-land trees — collated by Greenspace Information for Greater London (GiGL) for the Greater London Authority from the boroughs, TfL, the Royal Parks and other public land managers, with species, location type, size and age where recorded, and a 2090 climate suitability score.

fsa-food-hygiene-london.title: FSA food hygiene ratings (FHRS) — London
fsa-food-hygiene-london.description: Every establishment rated under the Food Hygiene Rating Scheme in the 33 London local authorities (the 32 boroughs plus the City of London Corporation), published by the Food Standards Agency as one XML file per authority, regenerated daily. The FSA keeps no public history — each day's extract replaces the last — so the monthly archive-YYYY-MM tags on this dataset are a historical record that is not available from the publisher.

tfl-network-demand.title: TfL network demand — daily station footfall and network journeys
tfl-network-demand.description: Daily demand on London's public transport network from Transport for London's open 'Network Demand' data (crowding.data.tfl.gov.uk): entry and exit taps at each of ~440 stations, and total Underground and bus journeys across the network, from January 2019. TfL publishes both as overlapping yearly and rolling two-year CSV files that it replaces about weekly, with late corrections and no public history. The tables here combine the overlapping files into single deduplicated daily series; the original files are kept alongside, and the monthly archive-YYYY-MM tags preserve versions TfL no longer publishes. Powered by TfL Open Data.

tfl-cycle-hire.title: TfL Santander Cycles — docking stations
tfl-cycle-hire.description: London's Santander Cycles hire network from Transport for London's open data: the inventory of docking stations from TfL's live BikePoint list — location, size, status and install date for around 800 stations. TfL publishes only the current list, so the monthly archive-YYYY-MM tags here record how the network changes over time: stations added, removed, renamed, moved or resized. Powered by TfL Open Data.
